headline: Reuters reports Meta paused a human-call fallback test in its Muse agent after disclosure concerns
summary: Reuters reports that Meta tested human contractors quietly handling some calls placed by its Muse agent, based on internal company posts reviewed by the news agency. The report says a Meta vice president acknowledged missing disclosures and said the feature had been rolled back for now; Meta’s spokesperson described the test as gathering feedback and said the calling feature would launch only with proper disclosure. The internal posts and underlying test were not independently inspected by the research desk.
